# 2 Baruch Chapter 40 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**40:1** And the dominion of my Anointed One which has been revealed will stand forever, until the world of corruption has ended and until the times that have been spoken of above are fulfilled.

**40:2** This is the vision which you saw, and this is its interpretation.

**40:3** And I said: O Lord my Lord, will I also be preserved until those times? Or who will be in those days?

**40:4** And he answered and said to me: Whatever will be with you — you will not know; but whatever concerns you — that you will know; for the Most High has revealed these things to you.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "dominion" (v.1) consistent with ch. 39:7; "preserved" (v.3) over PNEUMA's "survive" — the Syriac uses the same preservation/keeping verb used throughout the book for Baruch's own protection; the rhetorical structure of v.4 with dashes is preserved to show the two-part divine distinction.*
